correctness.rationale: Direct algebra gives F_delta(x)=2x(e^(1-delta)Q(x)-1)/(A+B) for x>0, positive denominator. A verified derivative identity reduces Q prime to H, and monotonicity of tanh(2x)/x shows a single maximum. Exact endpoint values yield all 1/3/5 root counts, stability, semistable boundaries, basins. The cubic origin expansion and finite-entrance argument cover boundaries and arbitrary initial x. Standalone high-precision verifier passed 806 independent formula/bracket/sign checks. Computation is auxiliary to the analytic proof.

value.rationale: It supplies an exactly located sharp nonlinear fold and global basins on the smallest network with two opposed fixed zealots and a persuadable agent. A stable neutral opinion can coexist with two stable polarized opinions in a quantitatively exact hysteresis window. This is a meaningful answer to initial-condition dependence not resolved by the original local-stability theorem; not just a computation, renaming, or arbitrary parameter slice.
